name: Apple Music Controls
summary: Apple Music player controls and AI tools
description: Favorite or unfavorite Apple Music songs, add songs to playlists, and see or reorder Playing Next in Ledge’s players. AI tools can inspect the current song, search Apple’s catalog for metadata and the local library for playable songs, manage playlists, control shuffle, list Playing Next, add a library song to play next, and favorite either the playing song or a library song. Catalog results are metadata only and cannot be played by this add-on. Music actions use macOS Automation permission. Playing Next uses a private macOS interface and is experimental.
author: Ledge
